title: First hearing in the Cem Özkaya case
paragraphs: The trial of Central Anadolu News correspondent Cem Özkaya on charge of violating the secrecy of the investigation has been held in the first hearing.

According to the indictment, Cem Özkaya violated the scope of the investigation with the details of the corruption investigation published on February 11, 2026. The sentence is carried out: the Turkish Penal Code 285 (infringement of the confidentiality of the investigation).
The trial was held on July 2, 2026 in front of the İstanbul 4th Criminal Court. The court postponed the trial until October 22, 2026.
In the case of Cem Özkaya, Attorney Tolga Erdem said the judge's motion to dismiss was denied.
Cem Özkaya works as a reporter for the Central Anadolu News broadcaster. Press occupational organisations have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
The prosecution will present its original debate at the next hearing, and Cem Özkaya is on trial without arrest.
